name: RBC count
summary: Also printed as mill/cumm (= 10^6/µL).

name: RDW-CV
summary: Plain "RDW" usually means RDW-CV (%).

name: Total leucocyte count (WBC)
summary: Also printed as cells/cumm (×0.001) or thou/cumm.

name: Absolute eosinophil count
summary: Often printed in cells/µL or /cumm (×0.001).

name: Platelet count
summary: Indian labs often print lakhs/cumm (×100).

name: PDW
summary: Some analysers report PDW in % — not convertible; keep as printed.

name: Plateletcrit (PCT)
summary: "PCT" collides with procalcitonin (ng/mL) — resolve by section/unit.

name: Neutrophil–lymphocyte ratio
summary: Derived; some labs print it.

name: Triglycerides
summary: "TG" collides with thyroglobulin (ng/mL) — resolve by section/unit.

name: LDL cholesterol
summary: Store method (calculated vs direct) in observation.method.

name: HDL / LDL ratio
summary: Order matters: HDL/LDL ≠ LDL/HDL.

name: Lipoprotein (a)
summary: mg/dL and nmol/L are NOT interconvertible — keep as printed, do not merge units.

name: Albumin (serum)
summary: "Albumin" also appears in urine routine — resolve by section/specimen.

name: Blood urea nitrogen (BUN)
summary: BUN = urea × 0.467 (mg/dL).

name: eGFR
summary: Store formula (CKD-EPI 2009/2021, MDRD) in observation.method.

name: Urine albumin / creatinine ratio
summary: mg/g ↔ mg/mmol: ×0.113.

name: Sodium
summary: mEq/L = mmol/L.

name: Glucose, capillary (glucometer)
summary: Home reading; stored as a vital.

name: Glucose, 2 hours (OGTT)
summary: Differs from post-meal glucose: taken after a 75 g glucose drink.

name: HbA1c
summary: % ↔ mmol/mol (IFCC): mmol/mol = (% − 2.15) × 10.929.

name: Estimated average glucose
summary: Derived from HbA1c.

name: TSH
summary: µIU/mL = mIU/L.

name: T3 (total)
summary: Plain "T3" = total unless "free" appears or unit is pg/mL.

name: Thyroglobulin
summary: "Tg" collides with triglycerides (mg/dL) — resolve by section/unit.

name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
summary: "Vitamin D3" on Indian reports almost always means 25-OH total.

name: Vitamin D (1,25-dihydroxy)
summary: Different test from 25-OH — never merge.

name: Ferritin
summary: ng/mL = µg/L.

name: hs-CRP
summary: mg/dL × 10 = mg/L.

name: CRP
summary: Check unit: mg/L vs mg/dL (×10).

name: Troponin I
summary: hs assays often report ng/L (×0.001 → ng/mL).

name: CK-MB
summary: Some labs report mass in ng/mL — not convertible to U/L.

name: D-dimer
summary: Units vary (ng/mL FEU, µg/mL FEU, DDU) — convert only within FEU.

name: Cortisol
summary: Record collection time.

name: AMH
summary: ng/mL × 7.14 = pmol/L.

name: Beta hCG
summary: mIU/mL = IU/L.

name: ANA
summary: Qualitative/titre; store as printed.

name: Blood group
summary: Profile-level fact; also write to profile.blood_group on confirm.

name: HBsAg
summary: Qualitative (Reactive / Non-reactive, Positive / Negative).

name: Anti-HCV
summary: Qualitative (Reactive / Non-reactive, Positive / Negative).

name: HIV 1 & 2 antibodies
